setupFailures.reason: Unsupported JSON Schema dialect URI in client handoff; all attempts retained as incomplete in separate archived run; corrected URI handoff then fresh Claude run.

protocol.citationNormalization: Only source/ packet-prefix removal when remaining path is in captured source; raw response and line ranges/quotations retained. Applied before sealing; changes recorded per receipt.
protocol.blinding: Uniform limitations-field removal in presentation copies, original retained; no model or arm mapping disclosed to judges. Finding style/content can remain identifying.
protocol.independence: Fresh CLI sessions and separate source packets on shared host, procedural source restrictions; not access-controlled isolation. Both judge families grade both review families.
protocol.usage: Provider counters differ, auxiliary model usage included where reported, CLI list-cost estimates not billed subscription cost. No equal-compute or controlled-latency claim.
protocol.customization: Claude initialization advertised plugin/skill metadata despite safe mode. Advertisement is not proof contents were loaded or invoked. Actual tool transcripts audited separately.

independentExecutionAudit.scope: Final execution-only audit of all sixteen model-review attempts: eight corrected Claude reviews and eight Codex reviews. Judges and score reconciliation are not included.
independentExecutionAudit.method: Independently recomputed every captured source hash, manifest and sealed receipt hashes, exact source quotations, client event tool counts, provider usage sums, normalization field diffs, all live bridge transcript hashes and retained report equality. Manually read review tool inputs and material outputs; did not execute reviewers or change run artifacts.

deviations.description: A successful unauthorized parent curation directory listing exposed answer-bearing patch filenames before source inspection and reproduction. No patch or label file contents read in the observed tool events. The keyword-defaults filename directly names the reviewed expected defect. The receipt does not disclose the exposure.
deviations.consequence: Contaminated assessment; retain raw receipt and scoring but mark ineligible for an independent unexposed detection claim. Do not substitute a favorable retry.

deviations.description: Created, edited and executed two fixed-name scratch scripts outside the packet in shared system temporary storage. Source files remained unchanged. Observed scripts loaded only the assigned source; no shared-file collision or companion-answer read was observed.
deviations.consequence: Record procedural scope deviation and possible shared-temp interference; no observed answer contamination from these scripts.

deviations.description: A mistyped server executable path caused an unsuccessful validation_plan attempt; retry met the exclusive trace guard. Reviewer removed validation_plan.json and successfully reran. Errors and recovery remain in immutable-by-hash event transcript; final trace is the successful retry, not an uninterrupted first attempt.
deviations.consequence: Preserve transcript provenance and report setup error/retry rather than claiming all initial exchanges succeeded.

deviations.description: Client terminated with Selected model is at capacity after four shell calls and 31,388ms. Exit code 1, no timeout, no terminal review response or completed usage record. Operator sealed an incomplete receipt with no findings; token usage and billed cost remain null.
deviations.consequence: Incomplete control, not a clean control or completed miss. Preserve attempts and denominator; no fallback or replacement review observed.

scoringInterpretation.description: Scorer marks overbudget observations incomplete, nulls missed count and makes their pair incomplete. It still retains adjudicated matched counts and claim verdicts in raw summaries; detected is not restricted to budget-eligible reviews. Current output-overrun case is repaired with zero expected defects, so it cannot add expected-detection credit. Exposure contamination is not represented by the frozen harness schema and needs a separate post-audit eligibility ledger.

limits: Tool event inspection does not prove filesystem isolation or capture hidden client internals.
Claude initialization advertises plugin and skill metadata, without observed invocation; this does not prove their instruction contents were loaded.
Claude usage includes auxiliary Haiku calls; primary visible assistant model is Sonnet 5. Provider token definitions differ.

No history, patch contents, labels contents, upstream web search, plugin or subagent invocation was observed in these sixteen reviews; the explicitly listed answer-bearing directory exposure is an exception to disclosure compliance.
Captured-source hash checks do not assert absence of newly generated untracked files.
All eight inspected MCP validation results are incomplete with unavailable checks, not clean validation.

judgeFallback.reason: Original Astra judge stopped with Selected model is at capacity before terminal assessment. Preserve failed attempt, declare a fresh Sol judge; review receipts and source unchanged.
judgeFallback.sourcePacketIdentity: A and B copied byte-identically; only operator identity in prompt changed.

judgeOutputRetry.reason: Original Claude judge exceeded its 5000 per-response output-token maximum while emitting combined judgments. Failed attempt retained. Fresh session with larger emission cap; review receipts/source/labels unchanged.
judgeOutputRetry.sourcePacketIdentity: A and B copied byte-identically; identity and compact-output instruction updated.

independentResultsAudit.scope: Independent reconciliation of all four final judgment/score pairs and audit of both final judge transcripts. No reviewer, judge, score or frozen evidence was changed.
independentResultsAudit.method: Rebuilt observation status, matches, misses, references, budget flags, claim counts, family/arm summaries and paired outcomes directly from frozen labels, assignments, sealed receipts and judgments without calling the production scorer. Checked all judgment bindings and exact coverage, source/presentation bytes and raw response extraction.

judges.exposure: No reviewer-family mapping, sibling judge output, external labels, upstream history, plugin, subagent or network command observed. Judge is authorized to see supplied labels and reference records.

eligibility.interpretation: Raw semantic detection totals are not eligibility-adjusted effectiveness totals. One Claude baseline detection is contaminated; each baseline has one incomplete control for different reasons. Retain selected denominators and all observations. No superiority or equal-compute claim follows.

deviations.description: Judge wrote and read two fixed-name summary files outside its working directory in shared system temporary storage. Contents were derived from its own authorized A/B presentation packets. No foreign content or answer leakage was observed.
deviations.consequence: Procedural boundary deviation; do not claim every judge read stayed inside its working directory.

deviations.description: Judge inspected frozen implementations but ran hand-transcribed inline functions rather than importing those snapshots. Its commands reproduce hyphen, some Unicode-v punctuation, digit-2 backreference and metadata behaviors; one initial punctuation command had a syntax error and was retried. No keyword-only-default execution occurs in this final judge transcript, although judgment evidence claims it independently reproduced the TypeError/42 behavior. Some exact digit-1, a&&b and fixed-source reproduction descriptions also exceed its recorded commands.
deviations.consequence: Preserve semantic verdict agreement, which is corroborated by Sol and reference evidence, but do not claim both judges independently executed every reported behavior against exact frozen source. Record unsupported execution-provenance claims as judge-quality findings.

limits: Agreement is agreement on this small historical development corpus, not independent proof of correctness or unseen effectiveness.
Judges knew supplied labels. Both saw the same reference records; correlated reference evidence is not separate semantic votes.
Source, wording and runtime descriptions allow partial unblinding even after uniform limitations removal.
No independent billed subscription cost measurement is available; provider tokens and client context are not equalized.
This audit reconciles score accounting and observed reproduction provenance; it is not a new exhaustive semantic review or independently rerun benchmark.

eligibility.reason: Historical exposed cases, unequal client contexts, incomplete validation and documented protocol deviations prevent a controlled superiority claim.

contaminatedAssessments.reason: Reviewer saw the answer-bearing copy-function-keyword-defaults-upstream.patch filename before reviewing the API. Raw supported finding is not an independent unexposed discovery.

incompleteAssessments.reason: Client did not produce a completed terminal assessment; capacity failure retained.

eligibility.rawScoresInterpretation: Scorer records semantic matches separately from completion. Raw detected totals include the contaminated finding; they must not be read as eligibility-adjusted effectiveness metrics.
